recognize_zh: 低倍骨髓抹片中央是一個富含脂肪空泡的骨髓顆粒，周圍與背景充滿大量單一形態的小圓形淋巴樣細胞，箭頭標出散在、深紫黑色顆粒密集的肥大細胞；小淋巴球大量增加並伴隨肥大細胞增多，是淋巴漿細胞性淋巴瘤骨髓抹片的線索。
features: Marrow particle with abundant fat spaces and cellular rim
Background dominated by numerous small, round lymphoid cells with scant cytoplasm
Scattered mast cells with dense dark purple-black granules (arrows), increased in number
Relatively few recognizable erythroid and granulocytic precursors
Low magnification; plasmacytoid features and plasma cells not resolvable
describe_en: Low-power bone marrow aspirate smear shows a fatty marrow particle surrounded by a cellular smear composed predominantly of small, round lymphoid cells with scant cytoplasm. Several mast cells with dense metachromatic granules are scattered near the particle and in the background (arrows), and erythroid and myeloid precursors are relatively sparse. Plasmacytoid lymphocytes and plasma cells cannot be resolved at this magnification. In the appropriate clinical context (IgM paraprotein, MYD88 L265P), the lymphocytosis with increased mast cells is consistent with marrow involvement by lymphoplasmacytic lymphoma.

ddx.vs: CLL cells are CD5/CD23-positive with smudge cells and lack a plasmacytic component, whereas LPL is typically CD5-/CD23- with plasmacytoid cells and IgM paraprotein.
MZL can show plasmacytic differentiation and mast cells, so separation relies on MYD88 L265P (frequent in LPL) and the clinical/nodal or splenic picture.
Systemic mastocytosis shows clusters of spindle-shaped, hypogranular CD25/CD2-positive mast cells rather than scattered round, well-granulated reactive mast cells among lymphocytes.
Hemodilution shows abundant red cells and mature neutrophils with few particles, rather than a lymphocyte-dominant particle-rich smear.
